</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>Eighteenth Stratagem</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>擒贼擒王</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(qín zéi qín wáng)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Defeat the Enemy by Capturing Its Chief</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
An early form of warfare in China was for two armies to line up
against one another and have the two opposing generals go forward on
horseback and fight to the death. The army of the victor would then
pursue and slaughter that of the loser.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
The poem 'Ballad of the Frontier' [10] by the Tang poet Du Fu (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">杜甫</span></span>,
712–770 A.D.) describes this strategy:</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
When you pull a bow, make sure it’s a strong one,</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
make sure that the arrows you use are long ones.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
To shoot a man, first shoot the horse,</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
to capture the foe, first capture their chief.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
Yet there are limits to killing men,</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
the kingdoms have their own borders.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
If only we can control their raids,</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
it does not depend on much killing.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
When Zhang Xun (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">张巡</span></span>,
709-757 A.D.) was fighting Yin Ziqi (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">尹子奇</span></span>)
in the battle Suiyang (755 A.D.), he ordered his archers to fire
arrows made from the less effective, but plentiful, wormwood. On
seeing such makeshift arrows, some of the enemy soldiers hurried back
to Yin Ziqi to tell him of this. Zhang Xun, seeing all of this, now
knew where the enemy leader was and had an arrow shot into his eye.
Yin retreated in agony and his army fell into chaos [5].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Earth
over Earth</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is stretched to its limits in response to the infinitely creative
heaven. As the yin line in the weak si<span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">xth
po</span></span>sition
attempts to hold a position of power, it becomes vulnerable to attack
and may be captured. It is in this sense that the second hexagram is
associated with the eighteenth stratagem, <i>Defeat
the Enemy by Capturing Its Chief </i><span style="font-style: normal;">[1],
[28]</span>.</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"></span>



</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>VOCAB LIST 18:</b></span></p>

	</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不会。</span></span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
-------------------------------------</span></p>
